## Introduction and Qualitative Purpose

This chapter formalizes infinitesimal dynamics and shows how continuous and discrete local models are constructed around nominal trajectories.

## In Laymans Terms

Even if the full system is nonlinear, tiny errors evolve according to a linear rule that we can compute and exploit.

## Geometric Intuition

Linearization gives the local transport rule between tangent spaces along a curve.

## Key Equations

$$
\dot{\delta x} = A(x,t)\delta x + B(x,t)\delta u,
$$

$$
\delta x_{k+1} = A_k\delta x_k + B_k\delta u_k.
$$

## Design Relevance

The local maps $A$ and $B$ quantify sensitivity and control authority, and they are the immediate inputs to LQR, DDP, and contraction checks.
